description: Defines the QuicReceivedPacketManager class responsible for managing received packets in QUIC protocol implementation, including packet tracking, acknowledgment frame generation, and related configurations.

classes.name: quic::QuicReceivedPacketManager
classes.description: Manages received packets, tracks packet states, generates acknowledgment frames, and handles related configurations for QUIC protocol.

methods.name: QuicReceivedPacketManager
methods.description: Default constructor for the packet manager.

methods.name: QuicReceivedPacketManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes with a pointer to QuicConnectionStats.

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Sets internal state based on provided QuicConfig and perspective.

methods.name: RecordPacketReceived
methods.description: Records the reception of a packet with header, timestamp, and ECN code.

methods.name: IsMissing
methods.description: Checks if a specific packet number is missing.

methods.name: IsAwaitingPacket
methods.description: Checks if the manager is still waiting for a specific packet.

methods.name: GetUpdatedAckFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the current acknowledgment frame.

methods.name: DontWaitForPacketsBefore
methods.description: Deletes missing packets before a specified packet number.

methods.name: MaybeUpdateAckTimeout
methods.description: Updates the acknowledgment timeout based on current conditions.

methods.name: ResetAckStates
methods.description: Resets acknowledgment-related states after an ACK is sent.

methods.name: HasMissingPackets
methods.description: Checks if there are any missing packets.

methods.name: HasNewMissingPackets
methods.description: Checks if there are new missing packets to report.

methods.name: peer_least_packet_awaiting_ack
methods.description: Returns the least packet number the peer is awaiting acknowledgment for.

methods.name: ack_frame_updated
methods.description: Indicates if the ACK frame has been updated.

methods.name: GetLargestObserved
methods.description: Returns the largest observed packet number.

methods.name: PeerFirstSendingPacketNumber
methods.description: Returns the first packet number sent by the peer.

methods.name: IsAckFrameEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the ACK frame is empty.

methods.name: set_connection_stats
methods.description: Sets the connection statistics pointer.

methods.name: ack_frame
methods.description: Returns the current ACK frame.

methods.name: set_max_ack_ranges
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of ACK ranges.

methods.name: set_save_timestamps
methods.description: Configures timestamp saving behavior.

methods.name: min_received_before_ack_decimation
methods.description: Gets the minimum packets received before ACK decimation.

methods.name: set_min_received_before_ack_decimation
methods.description: Sets the minimum packets received before ACK decimation.

methods.name: set_max_retransmittable_packets_before_ack
methods.description: Sets the max retransmittable packets before ACK (conditional compilation).

methods.name: set_ack_frequency
methods.description: Sets the acknowledgment frequency.

methods.name: set_local_max_ack_delay
methods.description: Sets the local maximum acknowledgment delay.

methods.name: ack_timeout
methods.description: Returns the current ACK timeout.

methods.name: OnAckFrequencyFrame
methods.description: Handles reception of an ACK frequency frame.
